title: Tokimeki Memorial Drama Series Vol. 2: Irodori no Love Song
native_title: ときめきメモリアル ドラマ・シリーズ Ｖｏｌ．２ ～彩のラブ・ソング～
overview:
"To remember something I had forgotten..."

At Kirameki High School, with the school festival close at hand, a new page of youth begins. Encounters, friendship, passion, and discovery. The second installment of the drama series fans have been waiting for!

You play the guitarist of an amateur band called Irodori, struggling to write a new song for the festival. A chance meeting with Ayako Katagiri, and something she says, changes how you think about your music as you try to create a song that is truly your own.

This is a point-and-click adventure in which the story moves forward by clearing minigames at key moments, including band performances where you play guitar along with the music.

- Two CD-ROMs
- Shuttle Mouse compatible
- 1 player

「忘れていた何かを思い出すために…」

学園祭を間近にひかえたきらめき高校で、新たな青春の一頁が幕を開ける――。
出会い、友情、情熱、そして発見。
ファン待望のドラマシリーズ第2弾!
